summary: WatchNexus v2.1.0 Testing Complete - Plugins, Playback Settings, and Skip Intro features verified. Fixed 2 backend bugs: 1) Missing playback_settings table, 2) analyze_all_intros using non-existent distinct() method. All 10 backend tests PASSED after fixes.

fixed.issue: Missing playback_settings table in SQLite database
fixed.fix: Added CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS playback_settings with all required columns

fixed.issue: analyze_all_intros endpoint using MongoDB distinct() which doesn't exist in SQLite
fixed.fix: Replaced await db.media.distinct() with proper query using find().to_list() and set comprehension

critical_code_review_comments: Plugins page (PluginMarketplacePage.js) is fully functional with auto-discovery, Installed tab showing anidb-metadata and discord-notify plugins
Import Plugin modal works with both ZIP file upload and URL import options
Playback Settings (PlaybackSettings.jsx) integrated into Settings sidebar under 'Playback & Streaming' section
Skip Intro/Credits toggles, Auto-Play Next Episode toggle, and Chromaprint status display all working
VideoPlayer.jsx has Skip Intro/Credits button UI implemented (lines 581-603) with data-testid='skip-segment-btn'
context_for_next_testing_agent: WatchNexus v2.1.0 features verified: 1) Plugins page shows installed plugins (anidb-metadata, discord-notify) with enable/disable and Import functionality, 2) Settings > Playback section has Skip Intro/Credits toggles, Auto-Play Next Episode, and Chromaprint status, 3) VideoPlayer has Skip Intro button UI ready. Backend had 2 bugs that were fixed during testing.

plugins_page.import_modal: PASS - Import Plugin button opens modal with file/URL options

settings_page_ui.playback_nav: PASS - Playback nav item visible under 'Playback & Streaming'
settings_page_ui.auto_play_toggle: PASS - Auto-play Next Episode toggle visible

video_player.skip_button_ui: VERIFIED - Skip Intro/Credits button code exists in VideoPlayer.jsx lines 581-603

bug_1_missing_table.cause: playback_settings table was not defined in database.py schema
bug_1_missing_table.fix_description: Added playback_settings table with columns: user_id, auto_skip_intro, auto_skip_credits, skip_button_duration, intro_detection_enabled, credits_detection_enabled, default_intro_start, default_intro_end, default_credits_offset, auto_play_next, next_episode_countdown

bug_2_distinct_method.cause: SQLite Collection wrapper doesn't implement MongoDB's distinct() method
bug_2_distinct_method.fix_description: Replaced db.media.distinct() with db.media.find().to_list() followed by set comprehension to extract unique series_name values

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real implementations with SQLite database
